entry.title: New: Resolution 262 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF TWO TOMMY LIFT GATES WITH INSTALLATION TO THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT

The donation from Vibrant Hawai‘i, with an estimated value of $14,440, would be used by Area I and Area II of the department’s Community Policing Section.
